name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you are proposing.

## Problem or Use Case

What problem does this solve? Who benefits from it?

## Proposed Solution

How should it work? Describe the user experience and technical approach if you have one.

## Safety Checklist

Before submitting, confirm your proposal:

- [ ] Does not require uploading or storing original evidence files
- [ ] Does not expose `pending_review`, `rejected`, or `retracted` records publicly
- [ ] Does not store exact GPS coordinates, full names, phone numbers, or identifying information
- [ ] Does not weaken or remove safety warnings shown to users
- [ ] Does not add claims of legal proof or event authenticity
- [ ] Does not add tracking or analytics

If any item above is checked, explain in detail why it is necessary and how it would be implemented safely.

## Alternatives Considered

What alternatives did you consider? Why is this approach better?

## Additional Context

Any other context, mockups, or references.
